request: Analyze GSE306842 and GSE306857 for PMID 42272974 (Physiological and functional characterization for high-throughput optogenetic skeletal muscle exercise assays.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.experiment: 30-min daily optical exercise experiment (S2.2.p2); RNA extracted DM day 14 (S5.6.p1); 0.6 mL media (S5.2.p1)
final.assay: bulk poly(A) RNA-seq, Singular G4 50-bp PE; nf-core/rnaseq 3.11.1, GRCm39/Ensembl (S5.6.p2-p3)
final.system: C2C12 ChR2(H134R)-tdTomato mouse myotube 2D monolayers on grooved fibrin, 24-well plates (S2.2.p1, S5.2.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: 6 biological replicates (wells) per condition, 24 samples per experiment (FIG2 caption, S2.2.p2, S5.4.p1)
final.primary_estimand: effect of ~2 weeks of daily 30-min optogenetic exercise at 1, 4 or 10 Hz vs unstimulated control on muscle gene expression, within the 30-min experiment
planned_contrasts: 1 Hz vs control (30 min) (FIG2 d; S2.3.p1; paper count only in a bar chart)
4 Hz vs control (30 min) (FIG2 d; S2.3.p1; paper count only in a bar chart)
10 Hz vs control (30 min) (FIG2 d; S2.3.p1; paper count only in a bar chart)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none: each well is one independent sample
final.paper_method: DESeq2 (R 4.2.0) with apeglm LFC shrinkage, BH-adjusted p (S5.6.p4); each condition vs control within its experiment (FIG2 d caption)

paper_threshold.effect_note: log2(fold change) > 0.5 on the apeglm-shrunken LFC; up and down both counted

final.paper_results: 1 and 4 Hz give comparable up/down DEG numbers; 10 Hz the fewest in both experiments (S2.3.p1). 30 min: Myog, Myod1, Myh1/2/4/7 up at 1 and 4 Hz, not at 10 Hz (S2.3.p2-p3). 60 min: muscle genes down vs control; Myh2 the most significantly down gene at 10 Hz 60 min (S2.3.p1, S2.3.p3). GSEA Hallmark/GO prerank, FDR q < 0.25 (S5.6.p4).
final.enrichment_plan: GSEApy prerank on DESeq2 LFC and p, MSigDB Hallmark and C5 GO, FDR q < 0.25 (S5.6.p4)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.2.p2 and FIG2 describe two separate experiments (30 and 60 min), each with its own unstimulated control (n=6) and 1/4/10 Hz arms (n=6). GSE306842 is the 30-min experiment. FIG2 d caption gives the DEG rule: log2FC > 0.5 and padj < 0.05, each condition vs control. S5.6.p4: DESeq2 + apeglm. The DEG counts are drawn as bars only; no numbers appear in the text.

GEO contact Ritu Raman, MIT = senior author
matrix has 24 columns (6 per condition) matching the 24 GSMs; the other experiment is GSE306857 (60 min)

deviations: Salmon estimated counts rounded to integers (paper's import method unstated)

method.reasoning: S5.6.p4: DESeq2 with apeglm shrinkage; the matrix holds counts so the route runs as stated. One model on all 24 samples, contrasts vs CTRL; apeglm shrinks each grp coefficient (log2FoldChange = shrunken, MLE kept as log2FoldChange_mle). pydeseq2 joint model (MLE LFC) runs as a sensitivity check.

threshold.reasoning: FIG2 d caption and S2.3.p1: log2(FC) > 0.5 and padj < 0.05 (bars show up and down, so |log2FC| > 0.5), on the apeglm-shrunken LFC carried in log2FoldChange of the primary tables. Audit: padj < 0.05 alone.

caveats: Paper DEG counts are only drawn as bars in Fig. 2d; no numeric comparison is possible, only the qualitative ordering (10 Hz fewest).
Controls are unstimulated but twitch spontaneously (S3.1.p2): the estimand is optical stimulation vs none, not exercise vs sedentary.
Duration (30 vs 60 min) is aliased with experiment/culture batch and is not compared.

study.reasoning: Paper-aligned route: DESeq2 + apeglm, paper threshold, each frequency vs control.
